query: SELECT lc.id, lc.userId, lc.twinId, lc.lineUserId, lc.lineDisplayName, lc.status, dt.name as twinName, u.name as userName FROM line_connections lc LEFT JOIN digital_twins dt ON lc.twinId = dt.id LEFT JOIN users u ON lc.userId = u.id WHERE lc.status = 'active';
